description: Vitae is a data-driven entity framework for NeoForge 1.21.1 that lets you define custom animated mobs, bosses, and NPCs through datapacks and optional KubeJS scripting.

mods.name: Vitae
mods.description: Data-driven Vitae for Minecraft modpacks. Define custom bosses via datapack JSON with GeckoLib animations and KubeJS scripting support.
